name: Damaris Cudworth Masham (Lady Masham)
shortBio: English moral philosopher and theologian; close friend and interlocutor of John Locke and correspondent of Leibniz; critiqued Malebranchian occasionalism, defending empirical moral sentimentalism rooted in maternal education and practical love.
centralQuestion: How do sensible desires, practical morality, and maternal social education ground moral virtue without relying on occasionalist asceticism or pure intellectual abstractions?

keyWorks.title: A Discourse Concerning the Love of God
keyWorks.description: Powerful refutation of John Norris and Nicolas Malebranche's occasionalism, arguing that love of God is expressed through benevolence to fellow humans.

keyWorks.title: Occasional Thoughts in Reference to a Vertuous or Christian Life
keyWorks.description: Treatise on rational religion, maternal responsibility for early education, and the civic necessity of women's enlightenment.
